features.feature: Comps list and map with ARV
features.quote: you'll see a list and a map of up to 20 recent sales comps, including their address, description, distance and sale information
With the DealCheck Pro upgrade, you can select which comps are included in the calculation by checking or unchecking the checkboxes next to them.
the DealCheck Estimate ... and the Estimated ARV Based on Average Price per Square Foot (recommended if you've edited the list of sales comps or uploaded your own manually)

features.feature: Comp similarity scores and comp report PDFs
features.quote: You will now see similarity scores for each comparable property in the app and in all property reports
Estimate after repair values and potential rents with confidence. View recent sales comps, comparable rental listings and market statistics.
Use our offer calculator to figure out the highest price you can offer to make each deal profitable. We use reverse valuation and over a dozen criteria
Set up detailed purchase criteria and focus on the metrics that are important to you. Instantly screen properties with your criteria
Create professional online or PDF reports with a single click. Add your custom branding and logo

features.feature: Nationwide listing search with rental and flip potential
features.quote: View estimated rental and flip potential of each listing, and analyze promising properties with just a few taps

features.feature: Future refinance scenarios for rentals / BRRRR
features.quote: You can now analyze future cash-out or term & rate refinance scenarios for rentals and BRRRRs

app_store.whats_new: Facebook sign-in is no longer available. You can still sign in with Google, Apple, or your email and password. Minor bug fixes and interface improvements

api_or_mcp: DealCheck points to the RentCast property data API from the same team: iOS 4.38.0 note 'Get access to millions of property records, value and rent estimates, comps ... with our new property data API: https://rentcast.io/api' (source https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dealcheck-analyze-real-estate/id1001869134), blog post dated 2023-10-10 (https://dealcheck.io/blog/category/news-updates/). No DealCheck-specific API or MCP established. RentCast is separately watched as a vendor.
